hot_path.name: RunResidentRows
hot_path.source_reads: x and residual are consumed once per row
hot_path.resident_value: FP32 u (native-quantized x+residual) remains in one UB row
hot_path.precision: native-quantize u after FP32 add; RMS/norm/bias all FP32; single cast at output

generic_path.name: RunGenericRows
generic_path.coverage: FP16/BF16/FP32 and all legal rows and D
generic_path.precision: same arithmetic chain as hot path

v003_changes.native_u_quantize: u = ToFloat(FromFloat<T>(float(x)+float(residual))) so the add matches native-dtype semantics before RMS (golden: quantize input -> FP32 -> cast out)
v003_changes.invrms_chain: value = u * invRms * gamma + bias with invRms = 1/sqrt(mean+eps) matching PyTorch x * rsqrt(var+eps) * weight
v003_changes.formula: output = u * (1/rms) * gamma + bias with rms = sqrt(mean(u*u)+eps)

submission.integration: G001 Child V003: native u quantize + invRms multiply chain
